items.title: From Linear B to Linear A: the problem of the backward projection of sound values
items.who: P. M. Steele and T. Meißner
items.note: Examines how far Linear B phonetic values can safely be projected back onto Linear A signs, the basis of every reading attempt.

items.title: INSCRIBE: Invention of Scripts and their Beginnings (ERC Consolidator Grant)
items.note: Five-year ERC project on Aegean and other early scripts that produced the SigLA database and several Linear A studies.

items.title: Giving Voice to the Minoan People: The Decipherment of Linear A
items.venue: Singapore Ministry of Education AcRF Tier 1 (2017-T1-002-193)
items.note: Singapore MOE grant (2018 to 2021) for systematic corpus analysis and a Python brute-force cryptanalytic test of candidate languages for Linear A.

items.title: Some unpublished Linear A documents from Khania
items.note: Publishes new tablet fragments excavated on Kastelli Hill, Khania, between 2007 and 2014, adding to the small western Cretan corpus.

items.title: Drawing lines: The palaeography of Linear A and Linear B
items.note: Compares sign shapes across the two scripts to clarify how Linear A was adapted into Linear B.

items.title: lineara.xyz
items.note: Open-source interactive corpus browser with transliterations, findspot map and regular-expression search, maintained through 2026.

items.title: Neural Decipherment via Minimum-Cost Flow: From Ugaritic to Linear B
items.who: J. Luo, Y. Cao and R. Barzilay
items.note: Automatic cognate-matching method validated on known decipherments, a template for testing Linear A against candidate languages.

items.title: SigLA: The Signs of Linear A. A Palaeographical Database
items.note: Searchable sign-by-sign database of Linear A inscriptions with drawn sign tracings for palaeographic analysis.

items.title: Some reflections on morphology in the language of the Linear A libation formula
items.note: Assuming VSO order and a polysynthetic verb, proposes nominal and verbal morphology from variants of the libation formula.

items.title: Aegean Linear Script(s): Rethinking the Relationship between Linear A and Linear B
items.note: Systematic palaeographic and structural comparison arguing for a closer, more continuous relationship between the two scripts.

items.title: The mathematical values of fraction signs in the Linear A script: A computational, statistical and typological approach
items.note: Assigns probable numerical values to Linear A fraction signs using combinatorial and statistical constraints.

items.title: Deciphering Undersegmented Ancient Scripts Using Phonetic Prior
items.note: Extends neural decipherment to unsegmented texts and tests closeness of undeciphered languages to known families.

items.title: Rebus compositions in Linear A?
items.note: Argues some logograms were used phonetically in rebus spellings at Hagia Triada, which would yield clues to Minoan word sounds.

items.title: Some observations on the language of Linear A
items.note: Argues the corpus records a single language and identifies a prefix and probable verbal root in the libation formula.

items.title: A Linear A Inscription from the Cave (INA Zb 1)
items.venue: Honors to Eileithyia at Ancient Inatos (INSTAP)
items.note: Publishes an inscribed object from the Eileithyia cave at Tsoutsouros, adding to the corpus of religious Linear A texts.

items.title: Minoan Cryptanalysis: Computational Approaches to Deciphering Linear A and Assessing Its Connections with Language Families from the Mediterranean and the Black Sea Areas
items.who: A. Nepal and F. Perono Cacciafoco
items.note: Compares Linear A sign sequences computationally with several candidate language families; results remain inconclusive.

items.title: Design and Origins of Linear A Picture-Based Signs
items.note: Reassesses the relationship of Linear A pictorial signs to Cretan Hieroglyphic, questioning a simple evolutionary sequence.

items.title: Recueil des inscriptions en linéaire A. Supplément 1 (RILA-S1)
items.who: M. Del Freo and J. Zurbach
items.note: First supplement to GORILA since the 1980s, editing Linear A documents found or published after the original corpus.

items.title: An archaeological and epigraphical overview of some inscriptions found in the Cult Center of the city of Knossos (Anetaki plot)
items.who: A. Kanta, D. Nakassis, T. G. Palaima and M. Perna
items.note: Publishes an inscribed ivory sceptre from Knossos carrying about 119 signs, the longest known Linear A inscription, without numerals.

items.title: On Aegean spices: decipherment prospects on Linear A and B spice-related signs
items.who: S. Ferrara, E. Salgarella and L. Bellinato
items.note: Proposes identifications for undeciphered spice monograms in Linear B perfume tablets and traces them back to Linear A.

items.title: Industrial plants and palatial culture in Bronze Age Crete: olive in Linear A documents
items.note: First systematic survey of the olive logogram and its ligatures across Linear A documents, by site and date.

items.title: The Undeciphered Aegean Scripts: Linguistic Investigations into the Languages They Encode
items.note: Applies syllabotactic and statistical methods to Linear A and related scripts to characterize the underlying languages.
